slides.title: UN chief: stop the fighting, spare civilians
Protect civilians. Support peaceful dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: UN News, Nov 2, 2026 (UN Secretary-General statement, Oct 31)

card.title: “Agree without delay to a cessation of hostilities”
card.body: UN Secretary-General António Guterres, Oct 31, calling on the parties in northern Ethiopia to spare civilians and critical infrastructure and to engage in good faith with mediation.
